Subject: POC sizing + request to hold capacity (AetherWorks)

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the demo earlier — AetherWorks is moving quickly and procurement asked me to lock in a short standby for the POC. Attached is our current sizing spreadsheet (Aether_POC_sizing_v1.xlsx). The ask is: can Redwood place a soft hold for 4 H100-equivalent GPUs for a 6-week window starting the first week of April? This would be strictly a standby claim while we finalize SOW and payment terms — we may convert to a dedicated commit depending on final numbers.

Key constraints:
- Target POC start: week of 2028-04-01
- Hold window: ~6 weeks; flexible by ±1 week
- Needs low-latency region: us-west (we'd prefer a cluster in us-west-2)
- Point of contact for procurement: Meredith (procurement@aetherworks.ai)

Can you confirm whether Redwood can place a soft-claim and what the expected confirmation timeline is? Happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

Thanks,
Evan Liu
Head of ML Platform
AetherWorks

Grace / team — inventory check below, keeping the timeline (week of 4/1) in mind. I pulled the live snapshot (attached) from the capacity ledger and cross-referenced scheduled maintenance & upcoming Dedicated ramps. Summary and recommended action: 

Inventory snapshot (us-west-2) as of 2028-03-23 08:45 PT:
- H100 baremetal-equivalents free: 18 nodes (each node ≈1 H100-equivalent)
- A100-v5 free: 96 accelerators (convertible to ~24 H100-equivalents at perf delta)
- Reserved but not yet provisioned (committed deals starting Apr/May): 6 H100-equivalents accounted for
- Planned maintenance window: Apr 10-12 (non-disruptive for dedicated pools but constrains burst window)

Recommendation:
1) Approve a soft-claim for 4 H100-equivalents from 2028-04-01 to 2028-05-13 and tag them in the capacity tracker as "soft-claim/AW-2028-042". This is feasible without impacting existing Dedicated commitments given current free inventory.
2) Condition the soft-claim on a 7-business-day SOW-sign deadline; after that we release the soft-claim unless sales requests extension.
3) Offer an optional A100-backed fallback (2x A100 pairs with quantization guidance) if the customer needs earlier scale beyond 4 H100-equivalents. Notes: performance will be ~15-25% lower for some models; we should document recommended batch/kv-cache settings.

I attached the raw snapshot (gpu_inventory_snapshot_2028-03-22.csv). If Marissa wants to hold anything longer or wants a formal Dedicated reservation quote we need to route to sales (pricing team) — Connor, can you draft the pricing/commit options so Marissa can present them?

-Karthik
